ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors and counterparties against the EMLCU national lists, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list and the CBE sanctions database; enhanced due diligence for PEPs, their family members and close associates in line with FATF Recommendation 12; UBO identification at the 25% ownership or control threshold; independent verification of source of wealth and source of funds for the PCBA contract manufacturing equity injection; negative news open-source monitoring; record retention for five years after the business relationship ends.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Electronic Companies Registry Portal (gafi.gov.eg) and the Commercial Registry of the Ministry of Trade and Industry (Maslahat Al-Shahr Al-Tijari)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory name must be rendered in Arabic script; a Latin/foreign-language secondary style may be registered but the Arabic name is the controlling legal identifier. The name must (i) differ from all existing Egyptian company and trade names, (ii) be consistent with the objects clause covering PCBA/SMT contract assembly and electronics trade, (iii) avoid proprietary goodwill conflicts protected under Law No. 82 of 2002, and (iv) not contain a prohibited token or any segment misleading the public as to nationality, regulatory status or public-sector relationship.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 10 working days after the GAFI name-rejection notice, counsel files a written administrative appeal (Tazallum) before the GAFI Companies Sector head, attaching the proposed Arabic name, a screen-print of the electronic search result, the trademark search certificate, and a brief on the name's distinctive and non-misleading character; if the administrative appeal is denied or not answered within 30 days, a judicial challenge lies before the Economic Courts under Law No. 120 of 2008; alternatively, counsel may reserve an amended name electronically before expiry of the 90-day reservation so as not to lose filing priority.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as the sole statutory seat: GAFI and the Commercial Registry require a physical, inspectable Egyptian address with a notarized office lease; a licensed serviced-office suite with permanent Egyptian staff and dedicated reception may satisfy the requirement, but a mere virtual mail-forwarding address is insufficient for PCBA contract manufacturing because the company must demonstrate local commercial substance, receive customs notices, and undergo tax and AML inspections.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 65% quantified risk of unannounced physical inspection within the first 18 months by GAFI, the Commercial Registry, the Egyptian Tax Authority and/or the National Social Insurance Authority to verify premises, equipment, employment and manufacturing substance; the risk rises to approximately 85% if the entity applies for expedited customs or free-zone status.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended, Articles 28-46 (Limited Liability Companies); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations (Decree No. 2310 of 2017); Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976; Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005 (tax card requirement); VAT Law No. 67 of 2016.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - One-Stop Shop for Investor Services, in coordination with the Commercial Registry Office of the Ministry of Justice and the local Notary Public (Ministry of Justice Notarization Department).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association (Aqd Al-Ta'sis wa Al-Nizam Al-Asasi) in Arabic, filed through GAFI Form No. 1 (Incorporation Application).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The statutory minimum share capital for an LLC is EGP 50,000 (approx. USD 1,600), fully subscribed in equal-value shares and paid in cash into a provisional bank account at a licensed Egyptian bank before incorporation. The bank's capital deposit certificate is the statutory proof of payment; no escrow account or escrow agent is statutorily required. The deposited funds remain restricted until GAFI issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the First Board Resolution is presented to the bank.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: First Board Resolution No. 1 of the founders acting as the General Assembly of the Company. RESOLVED: 1. The finalized Memorandum and Articles of Association are adopted as the Company's governing instrument. 2. The fully subscribed issued capital of EGP 50,000, divided into 5,000 equal shares at a par value of EGP 10 each, is approved and allotted to the subscribing shareholders in the ratios stated in the Articles. 3. The registered office within the Arab Republic of Egypt, at the address set forth in the Articles, is ratified as the official head office. 4. Mr./Ms. [General Manager] is appointed sole director, legal representative, and authorized signatory with full powers to complete registrations, open bank accounts, and bind the Company. 5. Corporate counsel is delegated to perfect all incidental filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Legal Pre-Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Central Commercial Registry Name-Clearing Desk (GAFI e-services portal or in-person service window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Name Reservation Request listing up to three candidate Arabic names, each bearing the legal-form suffix for a Limited Liability Company ('LLC'). GAFI screens the proposed names against the Commercial Registry database, protected trademarks, and names contrary to public order or national security. Upon approval, the name is reserved for 60 days, which is sufficient to complete incorporation.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form with three suggested names in Arabic
Passport or national ID copy of each founding shareholder (apostilled or legalized if foreign)
Notarized power of attorney for the filing agent, if applicable
Receipt of payment of the name reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is rejected for similarity or objection, immediately file an amended name request with alternative names; upon repeated rejection, appeal in writing to the GAFI Name Clearance Committee, which must decide within 7 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office under the Ministry of Justice (Real Estate Registration and Notarization Department)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding shareholders, or their duly authorized attorney, appear before the notary and execute the Arabic-language Memorandum and Articles of Association. The instrument must specify the corporate name, registered office, object clause expressly covering 'contract manufacturing and assembly of printed circuit boards and electronic assemblies (ISIC 2610)', issued capital and share structure, management powers, first general manager appointment, financial year, and dispute-resolution provisions. The notary stamps and registers the instrument; the notarized original is then delivered for submission to GAFI.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association in Arabic
GAFI name reservation certificate
Passport or national ID of each shareholder
Notarized power of attorney where a shareholder is not physically present
Detailed object clause description covering PCBA contract manufacturing (ISIC 2610)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises substantive objections, execute a supplementary rectification deed before the same notary; if the object clause is deemed overbroad, narrow it to 'contract electronics manufacturing and assembly services' and re-notarize before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of a Provisional Capital Account and Deposit of the Minimum Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian commercial bank (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr) acting under Law No. 80 of 2002 on Anti-Money Laundering and Central Bank of Egypt instructions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional corporate bank account in the LLC's reserved name, deposit the full subscribed share capital of EGP 50,000, and obtain the bank's capital deposit certificate (Shahadat Al-Iidat) addressed to GAFI. The bank applies enhanced due diligence on the beneficial owners and blocks the release of funds until the Certificate of Incorporation and the First Board Resolution are presented.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate
Bank account opening and KYC forms
Beneficial ownership declaration and AML/CFT questionnaire
Passport or national ID copies of authorized signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the bank identifies documentary discrepancies, provide corrected notarized copies or a fresh power of attorney; the capital deposit certificate is reissued within one banking day after reconciliation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing, Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (OSS) - Incorporation Team and Commercial Registry Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete incorporation application with GAFI's One-Stop Shop, attaching the notarized Articles, bank capital deposit certificate, lease or accommodation contract for the registered office, powers of attorney, and the general manager's written acceptance. GAFI verifies the object clause, legality of purpose, and capital compliance; upon approval, GAFI issues the Certificate of Incorporation, assigns the Commercial Registry Number, and activates the tax record (which generates the Tax Card via ETA linkage). The founders concurrently adopt and minute the First Board Resolution in the company's minutes book; no separate regulatory filing of the resolution is required.
required_dossiers: GAFI Form No. 1 (incorporation application)
Original notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Bank capital deposit certificate
Certified copy of the registered office lease or accommodation contract
Power of attorney and identification copies for all signatories
First Board Resolution executed by the founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues an objection, a deficiency list is communicated and the applicant may cure within 15 days without losing filing priority. Fundamental defects, such as an unlawful object clause or capital below the statutory floor, require a fresh notarized amendment and re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, VAT Registration and Social Insurance Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - Unified Taxpayer Registration Department; National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) - competent branch office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Through GAFI's post-incorporation desk or directly before ETA, obtain the unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) and the Tax Card required before commencing economic activity under Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005. Register for VAT under Law No. 67 of 2016, including voluntary registration to protect input VAT credits on components and raw materials, and apply for the appropriate monthly or quarterly filing cycle. Register the general manager and all employees with NOSI for social insurance and maintain the standard occupational injury policy. Books of account and authorized tax invoices must be implemented before operations begin.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Registry extract
Notarized Articles of Association
Tax Card application form and ETA registration questionnaire
Registered office lease contract
Bank account statement or capital deposit certificate
Founders' identification and general manager's appointment acceptance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If ETA rejects the Tax Card application due to address verification or ownership mismatches, cure by filing the notarized lease, utility bill, or an updated notarized certificate; substantive disputes are appealable to ETA's internal appeals committee within the statutory objection period of 30 days from notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Seal Registration, Municipality Activity Record and Operating Bank Account Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Administrative Unit of the competent Governorate; Commercial Registry desk for the seal specimen; licensed commercial bank providing the permanent current account
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company seal specimen and the general manager's signature card at the Commercial Registry. Obtain the municipal operating certificate (Rokhsat Al-Mahal) for the administrative office at the registered seat and pay the relevant local fees. Present the Certificate of Incorporation, Commercial Registry extract, and First Board Resolution to the bank to activate the permanent current account and release the initially blocked capital deposit. If the physical factory site differs from the registered administrative office, notify IDA and the municipality separately during industrial licensing.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Commercial Registry extract
First Board Resolution or minutes of the general assembly
Company seal specimen and signature card
Rental contract and site plan for the registered office
Municipal fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Bank refusals caused by changes in beneficial ownership are cured by submitting an updated AML declaration and renewed KYC documents; municipal objections are resolved by paying the applicable local fees and presenting a civil defense clearance or fire safety certificate for the premises.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA), Ministry of Trade and Industry, acting under the Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations (Decree No. 981 of 2017).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Facility Operating License (Rokhsat Tashghil Manza) - the PCBA assembly line is classified as a Medium-Risk (List 2) industrial activity, requiring an IDA operating license and site registration before production commences.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment - Central Department for Environmental Impact Assessment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 'B' (Initial Environmental Examination / IEE) for standard SMT and wave-soldering PCBA assembly without electroplating or hazardous chemical baths; upgraded to Category 'C' (Full EIA Report) if the facility includes electroplating, chemical wet-processing, or generation of substantial quantities of hazardous wastes exceeding EEAA screening thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge to public sewer must comply with Cabinet Decree No. 44 of 2000 and Law No. 93 of 1962 (e.g., pH 6-9, BOD not exceeding 300 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 400 mg/L, and heavy metals including lead and copper within the prescribed limits). Air emissions from reflow and wave soldering lines, including VOC and particulate fume extraction, must meet Ministry of Environment Decree No. 713 of 2020 limits. Hazardous waste streams, including flux residues, solder dross, spent cleaning solvents, and contaminated packaging, must be segregated, manifested, and delivered only to EEAA-licensed hazardous waste contractors under Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended by Law No. 44 of 2020. Use of RoHS-compliant lead-free solder is presumed consistent with the emission reduction requirements.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety and civil defense certification under Law No. 152 of 2001, issued by the Civil Defense Division of the Ministry of Interior, covering fire suppression systems, smoke detection, emergency exits, and evacuation plans. Structural load certification by a licensed engineering office is required for the floor bearing capacity of the SMT assembly lines. Occupational health and safety clearance by the Ministry of Manpower under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003 is required, covering machine guarding, ESD grounding, fume extraction ventilation, personal protective equipment, and the occupational injury register.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), an agency of the Ministry of Finance; official portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; electronic invoicing clearance portal: https://einvoicing.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing an Egyptian LLC must complete commercial registration with the Companies Registry (GAFI) to obtain the Commercial Registration Number; the LLC must then register with the ETA for the unified Electronic Tax ID (TIN/VAT ID) and tax card via the ETA electronic portal. The following notarized and legalized documents are required: certificate of incorporation and articles of association, board/shareholder resolutions authorizing establishment and tax registration, nationality/ownership proof, and audited financials or bank reference; non-resident shareholders must appoint an Egyptian tax representative or fiscal domiciliary agent with power of attorney. VAT registration is executed on Form No. 1 combined with the unified TIN application. The same TIN is used for income tax, VAT, stamp duty, customs, and e-invoicing, and must be activated on the ETA e-invoicing sandbox before issuing any cleared e-invoices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists in Egyptian tax law. Statutory elections available include: (i) optional simplified presumptive tax regime for small taxpayers with annual gross revenue up to EGP 2 million under Articles 42-44 of the Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005 as amended; (ii) Free Zone investment regime elections affording customs/VAT exemptions and reclassified income treatment for export-oriented projects; and (iii) Special Economic Zone (SCZONE) incentives requiring an approval-based election at the GAFI/SCZONE Investor Services level. Hybrid mismatch elections are not recognized for domestic pass-through classification, but taxpayers may elect, subject to Egyptian transfer pricing documentation, the deemed profit method for export service income only where statutorily permitted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016 on Value Added Tax, as amended by Law No. 67 of 2021 and subsequent decrees; administered by the Egyptian Tax Authority
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual turnover from taxable supplies during the preceding 12 months or reasonably expected in the coming 12 months, whichever threshold is first crossed; mandatory on the date immediately following breach of the EGP 500,000 threshold, with compulsory e-invoicing roll-out phased by the ETA according to taxpayer VAT registration cohort and annual revenue bands
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time fiscal clearance: every VAT invoice issued by an e-invoicing-enrolled taxpayer must be transmitted to the ETA JSON-Schema/XML validation gateway via REST API, where it receives a unique invoice UUID (fiscal stamp) and an embedded QR code before being legally accepted. The e-invoicing mandate is compulsory for all VAT registrants in phases by turnover cohort; retail transactions are currently migrating to the parallel electronic receipt (e-receipt) clearing regime. An uncleared invoice is disregarded for input VAT deduction purposes, and the taxpayer receives a sealed electronic invoice record that must be preserved for five (5) fiscal years. ETA interoperability tests and digital signature certificates must be completed before live operation; the statutory mechanism prevents duplicate invoice numbering across the integrated system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods physically leaving Egypt, direct supplies to recognized free zones, and qualifying international services supplied to non-resident recipients, are zero-rated (0% VAT) under law provided the taxpayer holds an authenticated export proof chain and, for services, can demonstrate the supply is effectively delivered and consumed outside Egypt. A PCBA contract manufacturer must identify each sale as directly destined to a foreign buyer or to an Egyptian licensed free zone customer and must not omit the designated zero-rating code in transactions within the ETA e-invoicing portal in order to trigger 0% instead of 14% VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Cargo Manifest/Export Declaration Form) duly stamped by the Egyptian Customs Authority evidencing exit of the goods from Egyptian territory
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill issued in the name of the exporter/consignee and evidencing physical departure within the declared period
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an Egyptian commercial bank, or a certified bank statement showing receipt of the export proceeds in freely convertible foreign currency
Zero-rated VAT e-invoice cleared by the ETA with the statutory export zero-rating code and QR fiscal stamp
Commercial invoice/purchase order and shipment proof package retained for mandatory 5-year fiscal inspection and Foreign Trade Law compliance
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA and Central Bank of Egypt jointly audit export transactions retrospectively; if the 180-day FX repatriation evidence or customs export exit documentation is missing, false, or the invoice was not cleared by the ETA e-invoicing system, the 0% rate is retroactively reversed to 14%, input VAT previously credited is clawed back, and the exporter is assessed a penalty equal to twice the VAT amount, delay fines, and suspension from export privileges. Material tax evasion, intentional issuance of forged export invoices, or misuse of free-zone zero-rating status triggers criminal prosecution, including imprisonment, and a statutory fine of up to EGP 50,000, in addition to revocation of refund claims with interest assessed at 2% per month, capped as provided by Law No. 67 of 2016, over a 5-year assessment window.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE; Arabic: البنك المركزي المصري), operating under Law No. 194 of 2020 concerning the Central Bank and Banking System, with additional FX and AML/CFT rulemaking authority
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Since the post-2022 flexible-exchange-rate reform, the Egyptian Pound (EGP) is convertible for current-account transactions (trade in goods/services, profit remittance, and foreign-investment income) provided such transactions are routed through an authorised Egyptian bank with complete supporting trade documentation. The capital account remains administratively controlled: inward foreign direct investment (FDI) must be registered by the receiving bank for balance-of-payments purposes, and any subsequent dividend or capital remittance to non-resident shareholders requires traceability of the original inward capital transfer, a corporate tax clearance certificate, audited financial statements, and settlement of the applicable dividend withholding tax (5%-10% depending on tax-treaty relief). Practical hurdles are primarily bank-level FX liquidity management, documentary scrutiny of large outward transfers, and the absence of a fully liberalised market for speculative or non-trade capital flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory repatriation timeline: export proceeds must be credited to the exporter's bank account in Egypt via an authorised bank within 90 days from the date of shipment for standard merchandise flows, with a maximum outer limit of 6 months (extendable by the managing bank or CBE where contract-manufacturing lead times justify an extension). Mandatory conversion ratio: under the current liberalised FX regime, the blanket conversion ratio has been removed; exporters may retain 100% of proceeds in domestic foreign-currency accounts and may earmark such proceeds against their own eligible import settlement obligations. However, all export receipts must physically enter Egypt through the banking system and be supported by the CBE export declaration filing; offshore collection or settlement through non-bank electronic channels is a regulatory violation.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (EGP and USD current accounts with trade-finance desk)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (EGP and USD current accounts)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (multi-currency treasury and LC advisory)
Operational Account and SME export-financing facilities
Cross-border transaction banking, multi-currency account, SWIFT and LC desk
Operational Account with export-support and international-parent linkage

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW. Egyptian FX and banking law permits only CBE-licensed banks and CBE-registered payment-service providers to execute corporate trade settlements, FX, and capital movements with Egyptian counterparties. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, Revolut Business) cannot act as the primary treasury bank for export-proceeds repatriation, capital injection, LC settlement, or hedging, and receiving export proceeds through an offshore EMI account would breach CBE repatriation rules. Such EMIs are usable only as ancillary collection wallets for non-core digital operating expenses, outside the regulated trade-payment flow.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory. CBE AML/CFT rules implementing Law No. 80 of 2002 require the LLC's manager(s), all authorised signatories, and each natural-person beneficial owner holding at least 25% to attend an in-branch KYC interview with original documents (commercial registration, tax card, manager's resolution or power of attorney, passports, and proof of address). Egyptian banks do not offer fully remote corporate account opening; a physical interview and in-branch signature verification are legally required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholders incorporated in a jurisdiction with weak AML enforcement or sanctions exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original passport and certificate-of-incorporation copies; beneficial-ownership diagram with signed declarations; shareholder source-of-wealth evidence (bank statements, audited financials); sanctions-list screening report from a reputable screening engine; board resolution appointing a local resident banking representative; CVs and professional references of directors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transaction values combined with low fixed-asset intensity, typical of a PCBA contract manufacturer operating as a merchant converter
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed customer purchase orders and demand forecasts; full supplier contracts specifying Incoterms 2020; transport documents (Bills of Lading or Air Waybills); customs import declarations for raw materials; narrative process description of the contract-manufacturing flow; headcount and facility evidence; annual audited financial statements demonstrating operating substance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: USD export proceeds with multi-jurisdiction raw-material sourcing (trade-based money-laundering red flag)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transfer-pricing policy or cost-plus margin documentation; invoice-matching workbook linking each sale to corresponding raw-material imports; CBE import and export declaration filings; engagement letters from freight forwarders and intermediaries; a rolling 3-to-6-month bank statement history evidencing the transit/toll-manufacturing pattern.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment routing through a free-zone or trading intermediary (mirror-trade concern)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Intermediary contracts evidencing commercial purpose; end-user certificates and certificates of origin; FATF or country-risk assessment output for the intermediary's jurisdiction; complete chain-of-title documentation; legal opinion from a licensed Egyptian law firm confirming absence of illicit structuring.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident shareholders must transfer funds via SWIFT MT103 or TT into the LLC's pre-incorporation capital escrow account at a licensed Egyptian bank, with the sender's details and the purpose stated as 'foreign direct investment in Egypt' (balance-of-payments code G.INV for equity/invested capital). The receiving bank is legally obliged to report the inflow to the CBE through the balance-of-payments statistical system, to register the foreign investor's stake in the bank's investment register, and to issue an investment acknowledgement that later serves as the precondition for outbound profit or liquidation remittance. After commercial registration is completed and the capital-deposit certificate is issued, the escrowed funds are transferred into the company's operational EGP and foreign-currency current accounts.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Approved clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 / TT for direct supplier payments covering components, tooling, and logistics, each supported by the CBE import-register filing, underlying invoices, and the authorised bank's import-transaction register; (2) SWIFT MT700 documentary letters of credit (sight, usance, or deferred payment) for high-value raw-material purchases; (3) SWIFT MT400 documentary collections for established trade counterparties; (4) MT202 cover payments for interbank settlement where applicable. All outbound FX payments are screened against CBE policy thresholds, the importer's registration status, and the customs import-monitoring system; a PCBA contractor should maintain an annual import/export budget lodged with the settlement bank to expedite transaction clearances.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX spot contracts (T+2 delivery) for converting export proceeds or funding supplier payments
Plain-vanilla FX forwards (typically 1 to 12 months) available from authorised Egyptian banks against genuine underlying trade exposure
FX swaps executed under a bilateral ISDA or similar master agreement with an authorised Egyptian bank for trade-related cash-flow matching
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps for longer-term liability hedging on a request-for-quotation basis from top-tier banks
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executable offshore or, where the domestic deliverable market is impaired, with CBE-authorised banks under applicable documentation policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the end of the financial year; for a calendar-year company, generally by 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties, tax on unpaid amounts, late-payment interest, tax audit, and enforced collection may apply. No uniform automatic annual-return strike-off timetable applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements and corporate data update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual filing or data update in accordance with GAFI requirements and the company’s financial year; timing should be confirmed through the applicable GAFI portal or service office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines, refusal or suspension of corporate services, compliance notices, and potential regulatory action against the company or responsible managers may apply. No fixed statutory strike-off period is generally prescribed for this filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of annual accounts and distribution of profits
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company partners through the annual partners’ meeting; filings, where required, are made to GAFI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual partners’ meeting generally within three months after the end of the financial year, subject to the Companies Law, articles of association, and applicable GAFI requirements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Manager liability for statutory non-compliance, possible administrative penalties, inability to complete related GAFI transactions, and disputes concerning approval or profit distributions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audit report and audited financial statements, where audit is compulsory
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company partners and, where required, GAFI and the Egyptian Tax Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Completed before approval of the annual accounts and within the filing period applicable to the company’s annual accounts and tax return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to appoint or retain a qualified auditor may invalidate or delay approval of accounts, result in manager liability, obstruct GAFI filings, and trigger tax or regulatory scrutiny.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual review of beneficial ownership and ownership-control information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company records; information may be requested by GAFI, the Egyptian Tax Authority, or competent anti-money-laundering authorities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least annually as an internal compliance control and immediately upon any change in ownership, control, directors, or beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or produce accurate beneficial ownership information may result in AML-related penalties, regulatory enforcement, banking restrictions, and manager liability.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An Egyptian LLC generally requires an auditor where the statutory conditions are met, including the applicable capital or number-of-partners thresholds under the Companies Law and its implementing regulations. An audit is also required where prescribed by the articles of association, financing terms, tax authority requirements, or another applicable law. The current threshold should be confirmed against the company’s registered capital and partner count.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards, which are substantially aligned with IFRS; applicable tax records and statutory books must also comply with Egyptian tax and companies legislation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company should conduct and document an annual confirmation of its partners, shareholding percentages, control rights, managers, and ultimate beneficial owners. Any transfer, allotment, change of control, or beneficial ownership change must be recorded promptly in the statutory registers and reflected in required corporate, GAFI, tax, banking, and AML records.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Managers and Authorized Signatories
Register of Transfers and Changes in Ownership
Minute Book of Partners’ Meetings and Managers’ Resolutions
Approved Annual Financial Statements and Auditor Reports
Accounting Books, Supporting Vouchers, and Tax Records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 500-2,000 per year, excluding rent, translations, notarization, courier charges, and special GAFI services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,000-5,000 per year for a small or medium-sized LLC; higher for manufacturing operations with inventory, imports, related-party transactions, or complex tax reporting

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Egypt Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 provides location-based capital investment tax deductions of up to 50% of investment costs for qualified projects in designated regions. Free Zone projects (administered by GAFI) can obtain a total CIT exemption on export profits. Manufacturing-oriented companies may also claim accelerated depreciation on production assets and an additional deduction for training and R&D spending.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return Form 18 - Legal Persons / Electronic filing through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) Injaz e-portal (injaz.mf.gov.eg)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months after the end of the tax period. For a calendar-year fiscal year ending 31 December, the filing due date is 30 April of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company legal name, tax card number, commercial registry number, registered address, legal form, and fiscal year-end. Also requires the national ID of the responsible manager and contact details of the local tax agent or auditor.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident LLCs must insert the Egyptian tax ID issued for their permanent establishment (PE), branch, or representative office. If no PE exists, the non-resident must file an annual explanatory return disclosing only Egyptian-source income and claiming DTA withholding protection as applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue from PCBA contract manufacturing operations, cost of goods sold, direct and indirect expenses, operating profit, financial income, and non-operating income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only profits attributable to the Egyptian PE under the contract-manufacturing function-profiles. Use a transfer pricing method consistent with the local TP documentation, e.g., cost-plus or TNMM on total production cost for SMT assembly activities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-back of non-deductible expenses (e.g., excessive entertainment, interest above thin-cap limits, head-office administrative charges not at arm's length, donations without dedication receipts). Deductible allowances, VAT corrections, inventory impairment adjustments, and free-zone export incentive disallowances are recorded here.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entries must eliminate double-counted intercompany overheads. Head-office cost allocations require documentary evidence and an economic substance rationale; arbitrary markups are disallowed and will trigger an audit adjustment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Taxable Income and Tax Computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of adjusted taxable income, application of the 22.5% statutory corporate rate, recognition of withheld-tax credits, prepaid installments, and investment incentives to determine the net CIT payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident taxpayers should enter only Egyptian PE profit as the base. Treaty credits for taxes paid abroad on Egyptian-source income are claimed by attaching a TRC and the DTA analysis. Do not claim domestic incentives unless the entity meets the operating, licensing, and actual expenditure conditions set by ETA and GAFI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial statements approved by accountancy standards, external audit report, tax-reconciliation tables, transfer pricing declaration and supporting Local File / Master File when thresholds are met, and certified copies of any capital or loan agreements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents must attach the Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from the residence state, plus a form applying for reduced withholding under the applicable DTA. Failing to attach the TRC automatically results in the full domestic withholding and income tax assessment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or non-filing of the annual corporate return triggers a fixed administrative fine of EGP 10,000 to EGP 50,000 for legal persons under Tax Procedures Law No. 206 of 2020, plus a monthly delay surcharge of 2% of the assessed tax due (capped at 20%) for each month of default. Failure to submit the transfer pricing declaration or documentation adds a separate penalty up to EGP 500,000. Chronic non-filing allows the ETA to estimate the tax base and to void the loss carry-forward.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Quarterly Advance Corporate Tax Installment Form / ETA Injaz e-portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Advance tax installments are generally due on the last day of the 3rd, 6th, 9th, and 12th month following the preceding year's tax base; exact dates depend on the ETA-installed payment calendar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prior-year tax liability, installment number, and advance payment amount.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents with a stable Egyptian PE must comply; non-residents deriving only passive withholding-taxed income are generally exempt from quarterly installments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allocation of the installment to income tax line payable and credit carried toward final annual corporate tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Advance payments are credited against the final annual CIT; any overpayment is refundable or offset after the final return is approved.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Missing a quarterly installment incurs a 2% monthly late-payment surcharge on the unpaid amount (max 20%), plus interest on overdue balances. The ETA may also block clearance and import/export certificates until arrears are settled.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on dividends distributed by an Egyptian LLC to resident and non-resident shareholders under Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005. No additional Egyptian second-level taxation on the dividend recipient.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a reduced dividend withholding rate under an Egyptian income tax treaty (DTA), the non-resident shareholder must (1) obtain a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the competent tax authority of the shareholder's state of residence, (2) submit a treaty-relief application and the TRC to the ETA before or at the time of the dividend distribution, (3) obtain an ETA clearance / reduced-withholding authorization, and (4) retain the TRC, application receipt, and dividend payment vouchers for at least five years. If the ETA does not approve the application on schedule, the full 10% rate is withheld and a refund application must be made within the statutory objection windows. For a partially or wholly-owned Egyptian LLC, the DTA may reduce the rate to 0%-5% if the shareholder has a direct shareholding of at least 20%-25% and satisfies beneficial ownership conditions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and technical fees paid to non-residents: statutory withholding rate is 20%; Egyptian DTAs typically reduce royalties to 10%-15% (e.g., 10% under the Egypt-UK and Egypt-France treaties). Interest on intercompany debt: statutory withholding rate is 10%; most treaties reduce interest WHT to 0%-10%, subject to beneficial ownership and the absence of a P.E. Bank interest on documented letters of credit and wire transfers is usually exempt if paid to an Egyptian banking institution operating in normal course.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not maintain a separate UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations code, but Egyptian direct tax law and the ETA's anti-abuse enforcement apply a functional substance test. A PCBA contract-manufacturing LLC must demonstrate actual physical presence in Egypt: leased or owned factory floor, SMT lines and equipment, qualified operational staff, inventory warehousing and risk, and substantive board decision-making in Egypt. A letterbox entity that does not perform manufacturing activity will be construed as a sham or as a dependent agent P.E. of its parent, resulting in profit reattribution, denial of treaty relief, and imposition of CIT, late surcharge, and penalties.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine_extra: Under Article 39 of Law 91/2005 and the ETA TP accepted practices, the Egyptian PE shall be attributed profits based on its assets, functions and risks. The PE filing guide requires a functional analysis proving that the Egyptian LLC bears core contract manufacturing risk, holds inventory, and employs the production force. Lack of substance also defeats any requested free-zone tax holiday.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing a corporate return that omits export proceeds, creating fictitious purchase invoices for PCB and SMT components, double-claiming free-zone exemptions, or materially misleading the ETA in order to reduce the Egyptian 22.5% CIT liability.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Tax Procedures Law No. 206 of 2020 and Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005, willful evasion is punishable by imprisonment for a term of 3 to 5 years and a fine of EGP 20,000 to EGP 200,000 or twice the evaded tax, whichever is greater. Delivery of evaded tax and 2%-per-month surcharges is mandatory, plus confiscation of assets involved in the false accounting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, managing directors, and signatories of the false returns can be prosecuted as principals. The corporate veil is pierced where the unlawful acts are attributable to an identifiable officer; travel bans, asset freezes, and passport confiscation are routinely imposed while the criminal audit is pending. Restitution orders may attach personal bank accounts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Sham Substance Arrangement
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Egyptian LLC is used only as an invoicing and Treasury channel while the actual SMT assembly, inventory control, procurement, quality testing, and economic decisions are made entirely outside Egypt; no board minutes; no operational management in Egypt; no compliance with the Investment Law physical-activity conditions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The ETA is entitled to recharacterize the arrangement, disregard the Egyptian entity, or attribute profits to a deemed Egyptian P.E., assessing 22.5% CIT on the full PCBA manufacturing margin. Treaty benefits are denied and the parent is denied such profits in Egypt. The company may also be subject to fines for misleading the tax administration and customs declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who knowingly uses the Egyptian entity as a shell or signs declarations that misrepresent the Egyptian operational presence can face civil recovery of the evaded tax plus interest. Where the façade is used to conceal foreign-controlled profits, the directors are jointly and severally liable and may be included in criminal tax evasion proceedings; personal travel bans are possible.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The PCBA contract-manufacturing profit is priced below the arm's length range (e.g., a guaranteed cost-plus margin of 2% while realistic market comparables return 8%-12%) and no Local File is prepared despite controlled transactions exceeding EGP 10,000,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA may impose a transfer-pricing adjustment that adds the difference between the actual margin and the arm's length median margin to Egyptian taxable income, subject to 22.5% CIT plus the 2% monthly late surcharge. Additional penalties for failing to submit the TP declaration and supporting documentation can reach EGP 500,000 per statutory demand.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign the tax return and TP declaration containing an unsupportable margin may be considered participants in a tax fraud offense. They can be held personally liable to reimburse the additional CIT and penalties if the company is dissolved or the board members' insulation is pierced, and the responsible CFO may be subject to a travel ban during the audit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering / AML and Cross-Border Payment Irregularities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using cash or unexplained physical fund movements for PCBA components in Egypt, receiving export proceeds into unaudited off-book accounts, or structuring transactions to deliberately avoid the Egyptian banking system, the Central Bank of Egypt foreign-currency rules, or the ETA and AML record-keeping thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Egyptian Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2002 and subsequent amendments, the offense carries imprisonment of up to 7 years and a fine of up to EGP 1,000,000; additionally, the funds connected to money laundering are forfeited and the bank account is frozen. Failure to comply with AML obligations on corporate ownership and beneficial-ownership registration is separately enforceable by penalties and business license revocation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners who direct cross-border payment flows through LC and TT rails with the purpose of masking tax crimes are treated as money launderers; they face personal criminal liability and seizure of personal assets. The corporate veil does not protect the underlying natural persons when the company is used as the instrument of the offense, and the management face up to the same imprisonment as the corporate fine.
